sections.heading: About the Service
paragraphs: Crowfoot is a browser-based ERD design and collaboration tool with free managed databases for development.

sections.heading: Free Managed Databases
paragraphs: You can create up to 5 free PostgreSQL or MySQL databases per account, for development, learning, and testing purposes.
Data persistence is not guaranteed. Databases may be deleted, suspended, or changed at any time without prior notice due to service operating conditions.
Back up any important data yourself.

sections.heading: Changes to the Offering
paragraphs: The free offering — supported engines, per-account quota, capacity — may change or end without prior notice.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is". We are not liable for damages arising from data loss, service interruption, or the use of the service.
Accounts and databases may be restricted if the service is used outside its intended purpose.
